reply_text:
*I’d hold the merge.* Found four issues against `main`:

1. *Card previews never use the new helpers* — `src/card.js:2` still returns the full, trimmed body. Neither `excerpt` nor `toPlain` has a production caller.
   *Fix:* Wire `toPlain` → `excerpt` into card generation with the intended preview limit.

2. *Short text gets truncated and always gains an ellipsis* — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`. `excerpt('hello world', 100)` returns `"hello…"`, and empty input returns `"…"`. This contradicts the README’s unchanged-short-text contract.
   *Fix:* Return text unchanged when its length is within the limit; append an ellipsis only after truncation.

3. *A word ending exactly at the limit is unnecessarily dropped* — `src/words.js:2–3` excludes the space at index `limit` from its search. `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` instead of `"one two…"`.
   *Fix:* Include the boundary at `limit`; update `test/words.test.js:6`, which currently asserts the incorrect result.

4. *Markdown flattening deletes literal content* — `src/plain.js:3` removes every underscore, asterisk, tilde, and backtick regardless of context. `"Use snake_case and a * b"` becomes `"Use snakecase and a b"`.
   *Fix:* Strip parsed Markdown formatting rather than globally deleting these characters.

All four existing tests pass, but they miss these regressions. Reviewed `59856d7`; no files changed.
